concept: GuardDuty: threat detection (compromised credentials, malicious IPs)
tests: Which managed service detects active threats: unusual API calls, communication with known malicious IPs.
expected: Amazon GuardDuty — ML + threat intelligence over CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs; enabled in one click. Triggers: "compromised credentials", "unusual API calls", "known malicious IPs", "minimal setup".
why_not: Inspector — software vulnerabilities; Config — configuration compliance; Trusted Advisor — best-practice checks.
